I found a bug.
https://deploy-preview-2408--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RangeSlider.default 

- set the price slider to > 2000 (2000 is the min)
- type 'mg'
- end up a slider with range outside the min max returned by the results
- remove the query
- range is now 600 - 2000
